# FindArrangements

> FindArrangements is a completely free sugar dating website. It connects
> Sugar Daddies, Sugar Mommies, and Sugar Babies in the United States,
> Canada, and Australia for mutually beneficial relationships.

## What this site is

- The only 100% free sugar dating platform — no credits, no subscriptions,
  no paywalls, no hidden fees, at any point.
- Members create a profile, browse other members, like each other, and
  chat once both people express mutual interest (a match).
- Available to users 18 years of age or older in the US, Canada, and
  Australia.
